vibe: Objective, rigid, authoritative, minimal, 'Old Money Tech', function-first.

headings.style: tracking-tight, font-medium to font-black for radical weight contrast

data_and_numbers.style: tracking-tighter for tables, metrics, and inventory codes

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tight gaps (gap-4, gap-6) for dashboards, generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside cards to prevent collision.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid border-stone-200. No heavy drop shadows. Crisp, flat, minimal.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm to maintain rigid, brutalist authority.

components_strategy.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-stone-200), no shadow. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
components_strategy.sidebar: Thin, dense, monochrome background. Active states use left-border indicator in brand-blue.
components_strategy.tables: border-collapse, bottom borders only, dense padding (py-2 px-3). Data aligns left. Use IBM Plex Mono for IDs, numbers, and dates.
components_strategy.kanban_pipeline: Rigid 1px borders, stone-50 background for columns, white background for cards. Use Shadcn + a standard drag/drop library. Ensure columns stretch full height.
components_strategy.buttons: brand-blue for primary action. Text must be white for contrast. Sharp corners.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts with monochrome scales + brand-blue accents. No gradients on lines/bars.

image_urls.description: Portraits for CRM contacts and team members
Minimal geometry logos for multi-tenant switching

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Brand-blue (#002FA7) background must have white text.
accessibility_and_testing.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based, e.g., data-testid='crm-pipeline-stage-column').

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React (Frontend) with Shadcn UI primitives, Nest.JS (Backend), Dockerfile at root.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_extension_rule: CRITICAL: The frontend is in Javascript. You MUST use .js and .jsx extensions for all React components. DO NOT USE .tsx or .ts files.
modules_to_build: Multi-tenant layout with organization switcher in the header/sidebar.
RBAC middleware on Nest.JS and frontend protection based on roles (Admin, Manager, Sales, User).
CRM: Leads table, Contacts directory, Sales Pipeline (Kanban board with drag-drop).
ERP: Inventory list, Invoice generation view, Purchase Orders, Supplier Management.
instructions_to_main_agent.design_rules: DO NOT USE Inter for headings. DO NOT USE soft rounded cards (no large border radius). Go brutalist, crisp, functional. Use rigid 1px borders.
